initial.chief_complaint: New chest pain during inpatient treatment for bloodstream infection.

presenting_complaint: New chest pain during inpatient treatment for bloodstream infection.
history_freetext:
Hemodialysis for diabetic nephropathy; end-stage renal disease.
Prior leadless pacemaker and drug-eluting stent in the left anterior descending artery for stable angina.
Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus bacteremia complicated by infective endocarditis; receiving intravenous antibiotics.
Chest pain developed during treatment for the bloodstream infection.
